messages.subject: sharing www and js directories
parts:
I have two apps in inst/ base and quant. Since the content of the www (and js) directory are identical across apps I would like the quant app to use the www directory in base. I assumed this could be done using addResourcePath. I tried several alternatives:

addResourcePath("www", "../../base/www/")
addResourcePath("www", "../base/www/")
addResourcePath("www", ".base/www/")

But none of these work. Can someone help out?

Vincent

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: sharing www and js directories
parts: Sorry but addResourcePath can only be used to register sub-paths of the Shiny app; it can't be used to serve up a folder directly at the root directory of the app URL. So you could use it for serving up JS for sure, but for the main HTML you'll still need separate files (you could just have a ui.R that calls shinyUI(includeHTML("../base/www/index.html")) though).
